ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) background pixels covering approximately 95% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) clusters concentrated at the distal tips and scattered mid-surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation base. High-contrast white geometric blobs (barnacles) localized at coordinates corresponding to the extreme left and right tips. Faint greyish-white circular mottling visible across the central and upper-mid sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an obtuse interior angle, forming a clear divide between the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the majority of the trailing edge. A distinct high-amplitude irregular indentation (notch) is visible on the upper-left trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave curves extending from the distal tips towards the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular white high-contrast pixel groups at the extreme lateral tips. Lighter, less defined circular scars ('ghost' rosettes) distributed throughout the dark pigmented regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sets of parallel, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the upper-inner regions of both the left and right lobes, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake mark scarring on both lobes; significant irregular traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy barnacle colonization at the lateral extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of white, raised three-dimensional barnacle structures concentrated exclusively at the absolute distal points of the fluke lobes.
